result.description:
About Us:

 Founded in 2006, MJI Group have developed a unique ability to understand their clients' needs and instill the culture of customer centric service excellence within our people, with a focus on providing tailored services while ensuring our staff members convey reliability and professionalism.

 A nationwide provider of all major telco services, MJI Group is able to provide an industry leading service with their services in order to create the most favourable outcome.

 
The Role

MJI Group is seeking a Cabler to join the MJI Group team on a permanent full-time basis

 Tasks:

 - examining drawings, specifications and work areas to determine positioning and connections for equipment to be installed
locating faults in telecommunications equipment using instruments such as ohmmeters, voltmeters, ammeters and transmission measuring equipment
- attaching wires and cables to appliances
- adjusting, replacing and repairing faulty items, and testing equipment using electronic instruments
- installing cabling for telephone, radio, pay TV and computer transmission
- joining cables and sealing sheaths with lead and thermoplastic
- erecting, testing and maintaining aerial and underground wires and cables, and radio and mobile phone antennae
- installing telecommunications equipment and appliances such as telephones, switchboards and data transmission equipment
- Installs internal telecommunications and data cabling, equipment and peripherals for computer networks, telephony, cable television and monitored security and fire alarms.
 
Skills and Qualifications:

To be eligible for the role, you must have the following:
• Relevant AQF Certificate III required including at least 2 years of on the job training
• At least 3 years of experience as a Cabler in a similar environment may substitute the formal qualification listed above;
• Have experience in upholding the proper health and safety requirements in the workspace;

Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.

Expected salary: $80,000 

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

result.description:
Metro Welder Services is Queensland's largest independent Welding equipment repairer with over 30 years of industry experience, leaders in servicing and repairs to all of the major brands of welding equipment. 

 We are seeking a highly skilled Electrical Service person with experience in repairs and servicing to welding equipment or associated industrial machinery. If you have had repair experience and are familiar with world leading brand names like LINCOLN, CIGWELD, MILLER, W.I.A, ESAB then this is an opportunity to join one of Australia’s best welding equipment repair shops. 

  Applicants must have:  

 
	 Current recognised Australian Electrical workers Licence 
	 Experience in repairs to welding or industrial machinery 
	 "C" class manual drivers Licence 
	 Great communication skills 
 

 The successful applicant will join a team of highly skilled electrical service technicians working from our headquarters in Brisbane's bayside suburb of Lytton, just a short drive from the Gateway Bridge on the Port of Brisbane motorway. 

 As well as working from our Lytton premises the successful applicant will also become part of our mobile service team working from a service vehicle around the Brisbane Metropolitan area. 

 Working hours are 38 per week with 4 weeks holiday with leave loading per year, some overtime is available. Wages are well above the award and are negotiable. 

 On the job training plus a vast resource of machinery information are on hand as well as a great team of friendly, skilled service technicians to make the selected applicants smooth transition into a great work environment. So If you’re looking for a great opportunity to join a motivated and highly skilled team of service technicians with job satisfaction then contact us now!
